name: services/housing/allocation_periods
description: Get information on multiple allocation periods
brief_description: Get information on multiple allocation periods

arguments.name: allocation_period_ids
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of allocation period IDs

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of allocation_period method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A dictionary: your allocation_period_ids will be mapped to dictionary's keys, and each value will contain an allocation_period object, or null, if no allocation period by given ID was found.
